package.name: chess_robot_executor
package.description: Robot executor for the dual-arm chess robot: turns /chess/move_plan (JSON pick/place actions) into SCARA joint trajectories and acknowledges on /chess/robot_ack. Pure-Python core (kinematics, trajectories, task planner, state machine) plus a thin ROS 2 node. All geometry/limits are PLACEHOLDERS until the Design team delivers the final arm. Defaults to dry-run (logs commands, moves nothing).
